question: Identify the display name of the user who owns the highest-scoring child post (i.e., with a non-null ParentId) that was created in 2011 and whose owner has earned a 'Student' badge. Additionally, this post must have received at least one vote of type 2 (upvote).

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033"
INNER JOIN badges AS T3 ON T1."XCL_052" = T3."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN votes AS T4 ON T2."XCL_026" = T4."XCL_067"
WHERE T2."XCL_040" IS NOT NULL
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2."XCL_029") = '2011'
  AND T3."XCL_003" = 'Student'
  AND T4."XCL_068" = 2
ORDER BY T2."XCL_031" DESC
LIMIT 1
